newsitem.title: USA: USWC prods prices fall ahead of holiday weekend.
newsitem.headline: USWC prods prices fall ahead of holiday weekend.

text.p: Wholesale prices for U.S. West Coast products eased Wednesday, as trade turned quiet ahead of the long holiday weekend, traders said.
"I think traders already checked out," one California-based broker said, referring to the afternoon market.
Los Angeles CARB gasoline fell one cent to 56/57 cents a gallon with San Francisco prices the same.
Buyers of conventional grade gasoline, for sale in Reno, Nevada, offered to pay 53/54 cents a gallon, a 1.00 cent fall from Tuesday, traders said.
Reformulated gasoline, for sale in the metropolitan Phoenix area, was talked one cent below CARB levels,traders said.
CARB diesel in Los Angeles fell about 1.50 cents to 56.50/57.50 cents.
